roomWorkflow.phoneRequired: Enter the guest's name and phone number.
roomWorkflow.invalidDates: Choose a valid arrival date and a later departure date.
roomWorkflow.unavailable: This room is unavailable for these dates. Choose another room or change the dates.
roomWorkflow.checkoutRequired: Open Rooms, select the room and choose Checkout to review the account and complete departure.
roomWorkflow.checkinRequired: Open Arrival to complete the room check-in and create its account.
roomWorkflow.moduleRequired: This terminal does not have the required module. Ask an administrator to enable it.
roomWorkflow.reservationRequired: Create a room reservation before checking the guest in.
roomWorkflow.locked: This stay has already started or ended. You can edit a booking before arrival.
roomWorkflow.connectionError: Connection unavailable. Keep this window open and retry when connected.
roomWorkflow.saveFailed: The change could not be saved. Your details are retained. Retry or check the reservation before creating another.
roomWorkflow.noBillingNotice: Arrival only: no payment or stay charge will be recorded. A room account requires Guest Billing.
